definitions.name: First Move
definitions.description: Make your first move in a multiplayer game.

definitions.name: Buzzer Beater
definitions.description: Win a timed game with less than 10 seconds on your clock.

definitions.name: Living on the Edge
definitions.description: Win a timed game with 1 second or less on your clock.

definitions.name: Chain Reaction
definitions.description: Capture 5 or more pieces in a single chain jump.

definitions.name: One Jump Wonder
definitions.description: Win an entire game from a single chain jump.

definitions.name: Rage Quit
definitions.description: Forfeit a game within the first 3 moves.

definitions.name: Night Owl
definitions.description: Play a game between 2 AM and 5 AM.

definitions.name: Speedrun Any%
definitions.description: Win a game in under 30 seconds.

definitions.name: Comeback Kid
definitions.description: Win after being down by 3 or more points.

definitions.name: Flawless Victory
definitions.description: Win a game without losing a single piece to capture.

definitions.name: David vs. Goliath
definitions.description: Beat a player rated 300+ points above you.

tournament.name: Autumn Cup
tournament.description: Eight players. Single elimination. First to ten captures.
